body: 台灣有很多夜市。晚上，大家喜歡去夜市吃小吃、買東西。夜市的東西好吃又便宜，有烤肉，有水果，也有很多飲料。很多學生下課以後，跟朋友一起去夜市，吃東西、聊天，非常快樂。
translation_en: Taiwan has many night markets. In the evening, everyone loves going to the night market to eat snacks and shop. The food at night markets is delicious and cheap — there is grilled meat, fruit, and lots of drinks. After class, many students go to the night market with friends to eat and chat. It's a lot of fun.

questions.q: 大家什麼時候喜歡去夜市？
夜市的東西怎麼樣？
很多學生下課以後，跟誰一起去夜市？

body: 你喝過珍珠奶茶嗎？這種好喝的飲料是從台灣來的，是台灣人在四十多年前做的。奶茶裡面有甜甜的「珍珠」，非常好喝。現在，世界上很多國家都買得到珍珠奶茶。你去台灣的時候，一定要喝一杯！
translation_en: Have you ever had bubble tea? This tasty drink comes from Taiwan — Taiwanese people invented it more than forty years ago. The milk tea has sweet "pearls" inside and is really delicious. Today you can buy bubble tea in many countries around the world. When you go to Taiwan, you must try a cup!

questions.q: 珍珠奶茶是從哪裡來的？
奶茶裡面的「珍珠」是什麼味道？
現在，哪裡買得到珍珠奶茶？

body: 台灣的便利商店很多，差不多每條街都有，一天二十四小時都開門。在便利商店，你可以買東西，可以付錢、寄東西，也可以買車票。晚上餓了也沒關係，商店還開著。住在台灣，真的非常方便。
translation_en: Taiwan has lots of convenience stores — there is one on almost every street, and they are open twenty-four hours a day. At a convenience store you can shop, pay bills, mail packages, and even buy train or bus tickets. If you get hungry late at night, no problem — the store is still open. Living in Taiwan is really convenient.

questions.q: 台灣的便利商店一天開幾個小時？
在便利商店可以做什麼？
台灣的便利商店多不多？

body: 台北的捷運又快又乾淨，也很安全，很多人每天坐捷運上班、上學。你只要有一張悠遊卡，坐捷運、坐公車都可以用，在便利商店買東西也可以用。有了悠遊卡，在台北去哪裡都很方便。
translation_en: The Taipei MRT is fast, clean, and very safe. Many people take the MRT to work and school every day. With just one EasyCard you can ride the MRT and the bus, and you can even use it to buy things at convenience stores. With an EasyCard, getting anywhere in Taipei is easy.

questions.q: 台北的捷運怎麼樣？
悠遊卡可以用來做什麼？
在哪裡買東西也可以用悠遊卡？

body: 在台灣，垃圾車會唱歌！垃圾車來的時候會放音樂，大家聽見音樂，就知道要把垃圾拿出來了。很多垃圾車放的音樂是「給愛麗絲」。晚上，大家帶著垃圾在路口等垃圾車，一邊等，一邊聊天，很有意思。
translation_en: In Taiwan, the garbage trucks sing! When the garbage truck comes, it plays music, and when people hear it they know it's time to bring out their trash. Many garbage trucks play "Für Elise". In the evening, people wait for the truck at the street corner with their garbage, chatting while they wait. It's a lot of fun.

questions.q: 垃圾車來的時候，會做什麼？
大家聽見音樂，就知道要做什麼？
大家在哪裡等垃圾車？

body: 台灣人很熱情，也很客氣。你在路上問路，他們都會告訴你，有時候還會帶你去。外國學生在台灣讀書，有問題的時候，老師和同學都很願意幫忙。所以很多人說：台灣最美的風景，是人。
translation_en: Taiwanese people are warm and polite. If you ask for directions on the street, they will gladly tell you — sometimes they will even walk you there. When international students studying in Taiwan run into problems, teachers and classmates are always willing to help. That's why many people say: the most beautiful scenery in Taiwan is its people.

questions.q: 你在路上問路，台灣人會怎麼樣？
options: 告訴你，有時候還帶你去

questions.q: 外國學生有問題的時候，誰願意幫忙？
很多人說，台灣最美的風景是什麼？

body: 台灣的健保很有名。有了健保，看病、拿藥都很便宜，醫院和醫生也都很好。外國學生在台灣住了六個月以後，就可以參加健保。生病的時候，不用擔心花很多錢，感冒、發燒都可以去看醫生，只要花一點錢。很多外國學生都說，台灣的健保又方便又便宜，在台灣讀書，不用擔心生病的問題。
translation_en: Taiwan's National Health Insurance is famous. With health insurance, seeing a doctor and getting medicine are both very cheap, and the hospitals and doctors are excellent. Foreign students can join the health insurance after living in Taiwan for six months. When you get sick, you don't need to worry about spending a lot of money — for a cold or a fever, you can see a doctor and only pay a little. Many foreign students say Taiwan's health insurance is both convenient and cheap; studying in Taiwan, you don't have to worry about getting sick.

vocab.en: to join; to take part in

questions.q: 外國學生什麼時候可以參加健保？
有了健保，看病要花多少錢？
很多外國學生覺得台灣的健保怎麼樣？

body: 過年是台灣一年裡最重要的日子。除夕的晚上，家人都會回家，一起吃年夜飯，有魚、有肉，非常熱鬧。吃完飯，大人會給孩子紅包，紅包是紅色的，裡面放的是錢，希望新的一年大家都快樂、健康。過年的時候，學校和公司都放假，很多人會出去玩。如果你在台灣過年，一定會覺得很有意思。
translation_en: Lunar New Year is the most important time of the year in Taiwan. On New Year's Eve, family members all come home and eat the New Year's Eve dinner together — there is fish and meat, and it is very lively. After the meal, adults give children red envelopes; the envelopes are red with money inside, wishing everyone a happy and healthy new year. During the New Year, schools and companies are on holiday, and many people go out to have fun. If you spend Lunar New Year in Taiwan, you will surely find it very interesting.

questions.q: 除夕的晚上，家人一起做什麼？
紅包裡面放的是什麼？
過年的時候，哪一個是對的？

body: 在台灣讀大學，生活非常有趣。校園又大又漂亮，有圖書館、餐廳和宿舍。下課以後，你可以參加社團，跟同學一起打球、唱歌或跳舞，認識很多新朋友。晚上，大家常常去學校附近的夜市，那裡的小吃又便宜又好吃。很多外國學生都說，台灣的大學生活讓他們每天都很快樂。
translation_en: Studying at a university in Taiwan, life is a lot of fun. Campuses are big and beautiful, with libraries, cafeterias, and dormitories. After class, you can join student clubs and play ball, sing, or dance with classmates, making many new friends. In the evening, everyone often goes to the night market near school, where the street food is cheap and delicious. Many foreign students say that university life in Taiwan makes them happy every day.

questions.q: 下課以後，學生可以參加什麼？
學生晚上常常去哪裡？
夜市的小吃怎麼樣？

body: 日月潭和阿里山都在台灣的中部，是最有名的風景。日月潭是一個很大的湖，湖水是綠色的，你可以坐船，也可以騎腳踏車。阿里山很高，山上有很多很老的樹。很多人早上很早起床，坐小火車上山看日出，太陽出來的時候，非常漂亮。阿里山的茶也很有名，去玩的時候，別忘了喝一杯。
translation_en: Sun Moon Lake and Alishan are both in central Taiwan and are its most famous scenic spots. Sun Moon Lake is a big lake with green water; you can take a boat or ride a bicycle around it. Alishan is very high, and on the mountain there are many very old trees. Many people get up very early and take the little train up the mountain to watch the sunrise — when the sun comes out, it is beautiful. Alishan's tea is also famous; when you visit, don't forget to have a cup.

questions.q: 日月潭是什麼？
很多人坐小火車上阿里山做什麼？
阿里山的什麼很有名？

body: 故宮博物院在台北，是世界有名的博物院，裡面放著很多幾百年前的東西，有畫，也有很老的碗。最有名的是「翠玉白菜」，它是用玉做的，好像真的白菜一樣，非常有趣。想了解台灣和中國的歷史文化，故宮是一定要去的地方。學生買票還可以打折，別忘了去看看。
translation_en: The National Palace Museum is in Taipei and is a world-famous museum. Inside are many objects from hundreds of years ago, including paintings and very old bowls. The most famous piece is the "Jadeite Cabbage," which is made of jade and looks just like a real cabbage — very interesting. If you want to learn about the history and culture of Taiwan and China, the museum is a must-visit place. Students also get a discount on tickets, so don't forget to go and take a look.

questions.q: 故宮博物院在哪裡？
翠玉白菜是用什麼做的？
學生去故宮買票，可以怎麼樣？

body: 台灣的水果又多又好吃，有人說台灣是「水果王國」。夏天有芒果和西瓜，芒果又大又甜；鳳梨很香，差不多每個季節都買得到。香蕉也很便宜，在市場或超市，花一點錢就可以買很多。一年四個季節，台灣都有不同的水果。來台灣讀書的學生，別忘了每天吃水果，對身體很好。
translation_en: Taiwan's fruit is plentiful and delicious — some people call Taiwan the "Fruit Kingdom." In summer there are mangoes and watermelons; the mangoes are big and sweet. Pineapples are fragrant and can be bought in almost every season. Bananas are also very cheap — at the market or supermarket, a little money buys a lot. In all four seasons of the year, Taiwan has different fruits. Students coming to study in Taiwan, don't forget to eat fruit every day — it's good for your health.

questions.q: 夏天有什麼水果？
為什麼有人說台灣是「水果王國」？
來台灣讀書的學生，別忘了做什麼？

body: 台灣的早餐店很多，差不多每條街都有。早上，很多人去早餐店買蛋餅、三明治，喝一杯熱豆漿。早餐店的東西便宜又好吃，花一點錢就可以吃得很飽。很多學生上課以前，都會先去早餐店買早餐。
translation_en: Taiwan has many breakfast shops — there is one on almost every street. In the morning, many people go to a breakfast shop to buy an egg pancake or a sandwich and drink a cup of hot soy milk. The food at breakfast shops is cheap and tasty; you can eat until you are full for very little money. Before class, many students first stop by a breakfast shop to buy breakfast.

questions.q: 在早餐店，你可以買什麼？
早餐店的東西怎麼樣？
很多學生什麼時候去早餐店？

body: 在台灣，街上有很多手搖飲料店，賣紅茶、奶茶和很多好喝的飲料。買的時候，老闆會問你要多甜、要多少冰塊，很多人都說「半糖少冰」。夏天很熱，下課以後喝一杯，非常舒服。
translation_en: In Taiwan, the streets are full of hand-shaken drink shops selling black tea, milk tea, and many other tasty drinks. When you order, the owner will ask how sweet you want it and how much ice you want — many people say "half sugar, less ice." Summer is very hot, and a cup after class feels wonderful.

questions.q: 買飲料的時候，老闆會問你什麼？
很多人買飲料的時候都說什麼？
什麼時候喝一杯飲料非常舒服？

body: 在台灣，路上有很多機車，很多人每天騎機車上班、上學。騎機車的人都要戴安全帽，下雨的時候，他們會穿上雨衣。你過馬路的時候要小心，先看左邊，再看右邊，看見沒有車了再走過去。
translation_en: In Taiwan, the roads are full of scooters, and many people ride one to work or school every day. Everyone who rides a scooter must wear a helmet, and when it rains, they put on raincoats. When you cross the road, be careful: look left first, then look right, and only walk across when you see there are no vehicles coming.

questions.q: 在台灣，很多人騎機車做什麼？
下雨的時候，騎機車的人會穿什麼？
過馬路的時候，你要怎麼做？

body: 台灣夏天常常有颱風。颱風來的時候，風很大，雨也很大，學校和公司都會放假，大家叫它「颱風假」。放假以前，很多人會先去超市買麵、麵包和水。颱風天最好不要出去，在家休息、看看電視，等颱風過去。
translation_en: In summer, Taiwan often has typhoons. When a typhoon comes, the wind and rain are very strong, so schools and companies close for the day — people call it a "typhoon day off." Before the day off, many people first go to the supermarket to buy noodles, bread, and water. On a typhoon day it is best not to go out; rest at home, watch some TV, and wait for the typhoon to pass.

questions.q: 颱風來的時候，天氣怎麼樣？
放假以前，很多人會先做什麼？
颱風天最好在哪裡？

body: 很多台灣人中午吃便當。便當是一個盒子，裡面有飯，上面放著肉、蛋和青菜，有的還有魚。便當便宜又方便，花七八十塊錢就可以買一個。學校附近有很多便當店，中午的時候，學生都喜歡去買便當。
translation_en: Many Taiwanese people eat a bento box for lunch. A bento is a box with rice inside, topped with meat, egg, and green vegetables — some also have fish. Bento boxes are cheap and convenient; for about seventy or eighty NT dollars you can buy one. There are many bento shops near schools, and at noon students love going to buy one.

questions.q: 便當裡面有什麼？
一個便當差不多多少錢？
中午的時候，很多學生喜歡做什麼？

body: 很多外國學生住在學校的宿舍裡。宿舍的房間不大，你會跟室友一起住，大家一起讀書、聊天，非常快樂。宿舍裡有洗衣機，你可以自己洗衣服，很方便。晚上讀書讀得餓了，同學們常常一起去買宵夜吃。
translation_en: Many international students live in the school dormitory. Dorm rooms are not big; you live together with roommates, and everyone studies and chats together — it is a lot of fun. The dorm has washing machines, so you can wash your own clothes, which is very convenient. When studying at night makes them hungry, classmates often go out together to buy late-night snacks.

questions.q: 學生住在宿舍，跟誰一起住？
宿舍裡有什麼，很方便？
晚上讀書讀得餓了，同學們常常做什麼？

body: 台灣人見面的時候，常常問：「吃飽沒？」他們不是真的問你吃飯了沒有，這是打招呼，就是「你好」的意思。他們也常問你要去哪裡、最近忙不忙。這樣的問候，讓人覺得很溫暖。
translation_en: When Taiwanese people meet, they often ask, "Have you eaten yet?" They are not really asking whether you have had a meal — it is a way of saying hello. They also like to ask where you are going or whether you have been busy lately. Greetings like these make people feel very warm inside.

questions.q: 台灣人見面的時候，常常說什麼？
「吃飽沒」是什麼意思？
聽到這樣的問候，人會覺得怎麼樣？

body: 台灣有很多咖啡店。很多學生喜歡在咖啡店讀書、寫功課，因為那裡安靜，也有網路。買一杯咖啡，就可以坐一個下午。考試以前，咖啡店裡常常都是讀書的學生。
translation_en: Taiwan has many cafes. Lots of students like to study and do homework in cafes, because they are quiet and have wifi. Buy one cup of coffee and you can sit there all afternoon. Before exams, cafes are often full of students studying.

questions.q: 很多學生喜歡在咖啡店做什麼？
學生為什麼喜歡在咖啡店讀書？
什麼時候咖啡店裡常常都是讀書的學生？

body: 台灣有很多高山，最高的山是玉山，有三千九百五十二公尺。很多人週末喜歡去爬山，山上的空氣很涼，風景也很美。爬山不用花很多錢，還可以運動，跟朋友一起去，更快樂。
translation_en: Taiwan has many high mountains. The tallest is Yushan (Jade Mountain), at 3,952 meters. Many people love to go hiking on weekends — the air in the mountains is cool, and the scenery is beautiful. Hiking does not cost much money and is good exercise, and going with friends makes it even more fun.

vocab.en: to hike; to climb a mountain

questions.q: 台灣最高的山是哪一個？
玉山有多高？
山上怎麼樣？

body: 台灣的夜市不只有好吃的東西，還有好玩的遊戲，像撈金魚、套圈圈。玩一次不貴，大人小孩都喜歡玩。晚上跟朋友去夜市，先吃小吃，再玩遊戲，大家又叫又笑，非常快樂。
translation_en: Taiwan's night markets have more than just delicious food — they also have fun games, like goldfish scooping and ring toss. One round is cheap, and adults and kids alike love to play. Go to the night market with friends in the evening, eat some snacks first, then play the games — everyone shouts and laughs, and it is great fun.

questions.q: 夜市有什麼好玩的遊戲？
夜市的遊戲貴不貴？
晚上跟朋友去夜市，大家覺得怎麼樣？

body: 台灣的夏天很熱，也很悶，常常下雨；冬天不太冷，很舒服。因為常常下雨，出門的時候，最好帶一把雨傘。夏天太陽很大，別忘了多喝水，太熱的時候，就在家裡休息吧。
translation_en: Summer in Taiwan is hot and humid, and it rains often; winter is not too cold and is quite comfortable. Because it rains so often, it is best to bring an umbrella when you go out. In summer the sun is strong, so remember to drink plenty of water — and when it is too hot, just rest at home.

questions.q: 台灣的夏天怎麼樣？
出門的時候，最好帶什麼？
台灣的冬天怎麼樣？

body: 在台灣坐公車又便宜又方便，用悠遊卡就可以。要注意，公車來的時候，你要跟司機招手，公車才會停下來。車上看到老人的時候，很多人會站起來，把位子讓給他們坐。
translation_en: Taking the bus in Taiwan is cheap and convenient — an EasyCard is all you need. But take note: when the bus comes, you have to wave to the driver, or the bus may not stop. When people see an elderly person on board, many will stand up and give them their seat.

questions.q: 在台灣坐公車，可以用什麼？
公車來的時候，你要做什麼？
車上看到老人的時候，很多人會怎麼做？
options: 站起來，把位子讓給他們

body: 中秋節是台灣重要的節日。這一天，月亮又大又圓，家人會一起吃月餅、吃柚子。很多台灣人也喜歡在中秋節烤肉。晚上，大家在門口或公園烤肉，吃東西、聊天，非常熱鬧。涼涼的秋天夜晚，坐在外面看月亮，心情特別好。要是台灣朋友請你去烤肉，別客氣，快樂地參加吧！這是認識新朋友的好機會。
translation_en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is an important holiday in Taiwan. On this day the moon is big and round, and families eat mooncakes and pomelos together. Many Taiwanese also love to barbecue on Mid-Autumn. In the evening, people grill at their doorways or in parks, eating and chatting — it is very lively. On a cool autumn night, sitting outside and watching the moon puts everyone in a wonderful mood. If Taiwanese friends invite you to a barbecue, don't be shy — join in happily! It's a great chance to make new friends.

questions.q: 中秋節的月亮怎麼樣？
中秋節家人一起吃什麼？
晚上大家在哪裡烤肉？

body: 端午節是台灣的傳統節日，時間在夏天。這一天，大家都吃粽子。粽子裡面有米，也有肉，有的還有蛋，非常好吃。很多地方還有划龍舟比賽，龍舟又長又漂亮。比賽的時候，河邊站滿了人，大家幫比賽的人加油，非常熱鬧。要是你夏天在台灣，別忘了嚐一嚐粽子，也去看看划龍舟比賽吧！
translation_en: The Dragon Boat Festival is a traditional holiday in Taiwan, held in summer. On this day everyone eats zongzi. Zongzi have rice and meat inside — some even have egg — and are delicious. Many places also hold dragon boat races, and the dragon boats are long and beautiful. During the races, the riverbanks are packed with people cheering for the racers — it is very lively. If you are in Taiwan in summer, don't forget to try zongzi and go watch a dragon boat race!

questions.q: 端午節大家都吃什麼？
粽子裡面有什麼？
大家在哪裡看划龍舟比賽？

body: 台灣人非常喜歡吃火鍋，尤其是冬天。天氣冷的時候，跟朋友一起吃熱熱的火鍋，最舒服了。台灣的火鍋店很多，有的店是「吃到飽」：付了錢以後，肉、青菜和飲料都可以一直拿，吃多少都可以。朋友生日或是考完試，大家常常約去吃火鍋，吃東西、聊天，非常開心。
translation_en: Taiwanese people love hot pot, especially in winter. When the weather is cold, sharing a steaming hot pot with friends feels wonderful. Taiwan has many hot pot restaurants, and some are all-you-can-eat: after you pay, you can keep taking meat, vegetables, and drinks — eat as much as you like. For birthdays or after exams, friends often arrange to go eat hot pot together, eating and chatting happily.

vocab.en: to arrange to meet; to invite

questions.q: 台灣人什麼時候最喜歡吃火鍋？

朋友生日的時候，大家常常做什麼？

body: 台灣有很多溫泉，台北的北投特別有名。天氣冷的時候去泡溫泉，身體會熱起來，非常舒服，很多人覺得對健康也很好。可是要注意：進溫泉以前，必須先洗澡，把身體洗乾淨。在溫泉裡不可以游泳，也不要大聲說話。學習累了的時候，去泡溫泉，輕鬆一下吧！
translation_en: Taiwan has many hot springs; Beitou in Taipei is especially famous. Soaking in a hot spring on a cold day warms you up and feels wonderful, and many people feel it is good for their health too. But take note: before entering the spring, you must shower first and wash yourself clean. In the hot spring you may not swim, and you should not talk loudly. When you are tired from studying, go soak in a hot spring and relax!

vocab.en: to soak in a hot spring

title_en: Opening a Bank Account and Getting a Phone Number
body: 剛到台灣的學生，有兩件重要的事要辦：到銀行開戶和辦手機號碼。去辦的時候，記得帶護照和居留證，有的銀行還會要求別的資料。開戶以後，你可以把錢安全地存在銀行裡。有了手機號碼，打電話、上網都很方便。這兩件事辦好了，在台灣的生活就容易多了！
translation_en: Students who have just arrived in Taiwan have two important tasks: opening a bank account and getting a mobile phone number. When you go, remember to bring your passport and your ARC (residence permit); some banks may ask for other documents too. After opening an account, you can keep your money safely in the bank. With a phone number, calling and going online are convenient. Once these two things are done, life in Taiwan becomes much easier!

questions.q: 有了手機號碼，做什麼很方便？

body: 很多外國學生想在台灣打工，這樣可以練習中文，也可以有一點零用錢。可是要注意：打工以前，必須先辦工作許可，沒有它，就不可以工作。上課的學期中，一個星期最多只能工作二十個小時。很多學生在餐廳或商店打工，也有人在學校裡幫老師做事。只要注意這些，打工會是很好的經驗！
translation_en: Many international students want to work part-time in Taiwan — it's a way to practice Chinese and earn some pocket money. But take note: before working, you must first get a work permit; without it, you may not work. During the semester, you can work at most twenty hours a week. Many students work in restaurants or shops, and some help teachers with jobs on campus. As long as you follow these rules, part-time work can be a great experience!

questions.q: 外國學生打工以前，必須先辦什麼？
上課的學期中，一個星期最多可以工作幾個小時？
很多學生在哪裡打工？

body: 在台灣，坐火車旅行很方便。高鐵最快，從台北到高雄，只要一個半小時多，可是票比較貴。台鐵比較慢，票也比較便宜，差不多每個城市都有車站。高鐵和台鐵的車上都很乾淨、很舒服。你可以在車站買票，也可以用手機買。放假的時候，坐車的人非常多，最好早一點買票。學生買票，有時候還可以打折。
translation_en: In Taiwan, traveling by train is very convenient. The High Speed Rail is the fastest — from Taipei to Kaohsiung takes only a bit more than an hour and a half, but tickets are more expensive. Taiwan Railways (TRA) trains are slower and cheaper, and almost every city has a station. Both HSR and TRA trains are clean and comfortable. You can buy tickets at the station or on your phone. During holidays there are a lot of travelers, so it is best to buy tickets early. Students can sometimes even get a discount.

questions.q: 坐高鐵從台北到高雄要多久？
台鐵的票怎麼樣？
放假的時候，最好怎麼做？

body: 在台灣，丟垃圾要分類。紙和瓶子這些可以回收的東西，不能跟一般垃圾放在一起；吃不完的飯菜是廚餘，也要分開。在台北，一般垃圾要放進特別的藍色袋子，這種袋子在商店買得到。剛來的時候可能覺得麻煩，可是習慣了就好。垃圾分類讓台灣的環境又乾淨又漂亮。
translation_en: In Taiwan, you have to sort your trash before throwing it away. Recyclable things like paper and bottles cannot go in with the general trash, and leftover food is kitchen waste, which must also be separated. In Taipei, general trash must go into special blue bags, which you can buy at stores. It may feel troublesome when you first arrive, but once you are used to it, it's easy. Sorting the trash keeps Taiwan's environment clean and beautiful.

questions.q: 吃不完的飯菜叫什麼？
在台北，一般垃圾要放進什麼顏色的袋子？
垃圾分類讓台灣的環境怎麼樣？

body: 在台灣感冒了，不用去大醫院，家附近的診所又方便又便宜。看病的時候，要帶健保卡，先掛號，等一下就可以看醫生。看完病，醫生會開藥，你在診所就可以拿藥。醫生和護士都很客氣，會慢慢告訴你怎麼吃藥。有健保，看一次病只要花一百五十塊左右。所以在台灣生病了，不用太擔心。
translation_en: If you catch a cold in Taiwan, you don't need to go to a big hospital — the clinics near your home are convenient and cheap. When you go, bring your NHI card and register first; after a short wait you can see the doctor. After the visit, the doctor prescribes medicine, and you can pick it up right at the clinic. The doctors and nurses are very kind and will patiently explain how to take the medicine. With health insurance, one visit only costs around 150 NT dollars. So if you get sick in Taiwan, there's no need to worry too much.

到了診所，要先做什麼？

body: 每年十二月三十一日的晚上，很多人會去台北101跨年。夜裡十二點的時候，101大樓會放煙火，又高又漂亮，大家一起大聲說：「新年快樂！」跨年的晚上人非常多，可是不用擔心，捷運整個晚上都不休息，看完煙火還可以坐捷運回家。如果有機會，你一定要去看一次。
translation_en: Every year on the night of December 31st, many people go to Taipei 101 to count down to the new year. At midnight, the 101 tower sets off fireworks — tall and beautiful — and everyone shouts together, "Happy New Year!" There are huge crowds that night, but don't worry: the MRT runs all night long, so after the fireworks you can still take the MRT home. If you have the chance, you must go see it once.

vocab.en: to celebrate New Year's Eve; countdown

questions.q: 101大樓什麼時候放煙火？
跨年的晚上，捷運怎麼樣？
放煙火的時候，大家一起大聲說什麼？

body: 台灣的廟很多，差不多每個地方都有，很多廟又老又漂亮。大家常去廟裡拜拜：他們把香拿在手上，跟神明說話，希望家人健康、快樂。考試以前，很多學生會去拜文昌帝君，希望考試考得好。過年的時候，廟裡人更多，非常熱鬧。不拜拜也沒關係，你可以去廟裡走走，看看台灣的傳統文化，也是很好的經驗。
translation_en: Taiwan has many temples — there is one almost everywhere — and many are old and beautiful. People often go to the temple to worship: they hold incense in their hands and speak to the gods, wishing their families health and happiness. Before exams, many students go to pray to Wenchang Dijun, the god of studies, hoping to do well. During Lunar New Year, temples are even more crowded and lively. It's fine if you don't worship — you can still visit a temple, take a walk around, and see Taiwan's traditional culture. That is a great experience too.

questions.q: 很多人去廟裡做什麼？
考試以前，很多學生會去拜誰？
拜拜的時候，大家把什麼拿在手上？

body: 台灣的圖書館又多又舒服，進去不用錢。裡面很安靜，夏天還有冷氣，是讀書最好的地方。圖書館裡書很多，也有電腦，可以上網找資料。考試以前，很多學生一大早就去圖書館，找一個位子，準備考試。有了學生證，還可以把書借回家慢慢看。週末沒事的時候，去圖書館看看書吧！
translation_en: Taiwan's libraries are numerous and comfortable, and entry is free. Inside it is very quiet, and in summer there is air conditioning — the best place to study. Libraries have lots of books, plus computers you can use to go online and look things up. Before exams, many students go to the library early in the morning to find a seat and prepare. With a student card, you can also borrow books and take them home to read at your own pace. When you're free on the weekend, go read at the library!
